s: Din sukka yeshana ubo g' seipim: sukka yeshana, dehaynu sheasaah qodem sheloshim yom shellipne hechag — keshera, ubilbad sheyyechaddesh bah leshem hechag. Veim asaah leshem chag apillu mittechillat hashshana — en tzarik lechaddesh bah dabar:

Chiddush zeh sheamarnu — tzarik sheyyehe begup hassekak, dehaynu sheyyanniach sekak chadash leshem hechag, vaapillu en bassekak hamchuddash ella tepach al tepach merubba — day bekak. Veim orek hachiddush hu holek al pene kol orek o lerochab hassukka, apillu en berochbo ella kol shehu — day bekak. Vekol zeh bassekak, abal baddepanot apillu asaan mittechillat hashshana beberur shello leshem hechag — eno tzarik lechaddesh bahem dabar:

Yotzer keli cheres sheyyesh lo shette sukkot zo lipnim mizzo ushettehen asuyot letzel veoseh qederotayv bappenimit umokeram bachitzona — happenimit eno yotze bah yede sukka, ap al pi shehi asuya letzel, mikkol maqom kevan shehi dirato kol hashshana shehu okel veyashen bah veoseh bah rob tashmisho — en nikkar shehu dar bah atta leshem mitzva, abal hachitzona yotze bah yede sukka, shehare eno dar bah kol hashshana, vaapillu happenimit im magbiah et hassekak vechozer umannicho leshem sukka — keshera, shehare apillu tiqrat habbayit mitkashsheret lesikkuk al yede maaseh zo kemo shennitbaer besiman trl"a:
